Name: Dodavah, of Mareshah
Summary: Dodavah of Mareshah was the father of Eliezer the prophet who spoke against Jehoshaphat's alliance with Ahaziah.
KeyStory: Dodavah is named only as the father of Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah.
LifeLesson: A prophet's home town and father anchor his word in a real place.
